Messages.Author: Ric Rogers
Messages.Body:
Is it true that there will be an initial Jyhad release of limited edition
black border cards followed by an unlimited white border release?

Also I hear that the November release is called The Ice Age.

Ric

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Ric Rogers <ric4aardvark@delphi.com> wrote:
>Is it true that there will be an initial Jyhad release of limited edition
>black border cards followed by an unlimited white border release?

The initial release of Jyhad will be black-bordered.  If it sells well
enough to warrant an "unlimited" printing, it will switch to being
white-bordered.

>Also I hear that the November release is called The Ice Age.

No, the November release is Fallen Empires.  Ice Age is a maybe expansion,
maybe standalone game, which is on indefinite hold.
